propositions: Fourteen test modules hand-build nested pytest invocations, duplicating logic for basetemp, timeout, cache plugin, and env handling across sites including three that lack --basetemp entirely.

A centralized run_nested_pytest helper must build argv with sys.executable, -m, pytest, forward caller env verbatim without merging or widening, create missing tmp_path parents, and propagate subprocess.TimeoutExpired unmodified.

All fourteen hand-built launch sites must convert to the helper while preserving per-site divergences (timeout values, -n flag, --collect-only, etc.) and security constraints (minimal env mappings, cwd inheritance, no console-script re-wrapping).
An AST-based guard must detect any new sys.executable/-m/pytest launch literal in tests/**/*.py outside the helper, with optional escape-marker # nested-pytest-ok: <reason> for prose and edge cases.

The helper implementation must satisfy a strict call contract pinned by test_repo_isolation_deadline_heldout.py: timeout as subprocess.run keyword, CompletedProcess returned by identity, plain-dict env untouched.
